description.en: Answer the night question. The displayed variant may change the team you need to help.
description.zh: 回答夜间问题。本局变体可能改变你的胜利阵营。

description.en: Meet the other aliens and follow this round’s displayed alien instruction.
description.zh: 辨认其他外星人，并执行本局显示的外星行动。

description.en: Meet the aliens, but you only win if you die. Your death defeats the alien and village teams.
description.zh: 与外星人互认，但只有自己死亡才获胜；你的死亡使外星人与村民阵营失败。

description.en: Learn whether an alien is sitting next to you, without learning which neighbor.
description.zh: 获知相邻玩家中是否有外星人，但不会得知是哪一位。

description.en: Meet the aliens and Zerb. If both of you remain in play, survive while Zerb dies; otherwise win with aliens.
description.zh: 与外星人和泽尔布互认。若双方最终都在玩家手中，需自己存活且泽尔布死亡；否则随外星人获胜。

description.en: Meet the aliens and Groob. If both remain in play, survive while Groob dies; otherwise win with aliens.
description.zh: 与外星人和古鲁布互认。若双方最终都在玩家手中，需自己存活且古鲁布死亡；否则随外星人获胜。

description.en: Identify the original aliens. With Groob and Zerb together, protect both; otherwise help the village.
description.zh: 辨认最初的外星人。古鲁布与泽尔布同时在场时需保全双方，否则帮助村民。

description.en: Privately inspect cards according to the count and restrictions announced for this round.
description.zh: 按本局公布的数量和限制，秘密查看身份牌。

description.en: Move cards without viewing them according to the round’s displayed instructions.
description.zh: 按本局指示移动身份牌，不能查看牌面。

description.en: Reveal exactly the announced number of center cards to everyone, or reveal none.
description.zh: 公开翻开本局指定数量的中央牌，也可选择全部不翻。

description.en: Win if you and the announced neighbors of the final Blob card all survive.
description.zh: 最终持有黏液怪者及本局指定的相邻玩家都存活即获胜。

description.en: Inspect permitted neighboring cards. Win if a neighbor of the final Mortician holder dies.
description.zh: 查看本局允许的相邻身份牌。最终持有殡葬师者的任一邻居死亡即获胜。

description.en: Learn who has actually viewed or moved cards so far tonight.
description.zh: 获知今夜截至此时真正查看过或移动过身份牌的玩家。

description.en: Become a werewolf or vampire if one votes for you. This conversion happens before the result.
description.zh: 若狼人或吸血鬼投你，你会在结算前变成对应阵营成员。

description.en: Votes against you do not count. The next eligible highest vote count may die instead.
description.zh: 投给你的票不计入，其他最高有效票数的玩家可能死亡。

description.en: Identify the Tanner and win if the final Tanner dies. If no Tanner remains, you must die instead.
description.zh: 辨认皮匠。最终皮匠死亡则获胜；若没有皮匠，则需自己死亡。

description.en: Identify the original Seer and Apprentice Seer; you may inspect their current cards.
description.zh: 辨认最初的预言家及预言家学徒，并可查看他们当前的身份牌。

description.en: You may secretly notify one adjacent player that a Thing touched them.
description.zh: 可秘密轻触一位相邻玩家，让其知道受到了夜行怪的触碰。

description.en: Identify the original werewolves and inspect their current cards. Help the wolves; with none left, another player must die.
description.zh: 辨认最初的狼人并查看他们当前的牌。随狼人获胜；若已无狼人，需另一名玩家死亡。

description.en: Exchange with a non-alien and view that card. Both your original card and the stolen physical card become aliens.
description.zh: 与非外星人交换并查看其身份。你的原牌及夺取的那张实体牌都会成为外星牌。

description.en: See the private yes-or-no responses of other players to this round’s question.
description.zh: 查看其他玩家对本局问题给出的秘密是非回答。

description.en: View up to three cards. Your last inspected card determines your publicly announced team; survive and help it win.
description.zh: 最多依次查看三张牌。最后一张决定并公布你的阵营；须存活且该阵营获胜。

description.en: Protect yourself and the announced family neighbors of the final card holder. All must survive.
description.zh: 保全最终持牌者及公布的相邻家庭成员；所有人存活才获胜。

description.en: If a villain votes for you, become a villain before the result is resolved.
description.zh: 如果反派投你，你会在结算前变成反派。

description.en: The player you vote for cannot be caught. The next eligible highest vote count may die.
description.zh: 你所投票的玩家不会被捕，其他最高有效票数玩家可能死亡。

description.en: Votes against you are ignored when determining who gets caught.
description.zh: 决定谁被捕时，投给你的票不计入。

description.en: If the vote would catch you, the player you voted for is caught instead.
description.zh: 若你将因投票被捕，改为捕捉你所投的玩家。

description.en: Copy one center card. Keep your own card, but act later as that role and take its team.
description.zh: 复制一张中央牌。保留自身牌，之后按复制角色行动并加入其阵营。

description.en: Meet the villains. You may replace a non-villain player’s card with the extra villain reserve card.
description.zh: 与反派互认。可将一位非反派玩家的身份与额外反派备用牌交换。

description.en: Meet the villains; you may privately view another player’s card.
description.zh: 与反派互认，并可秘密查看另一名玩家的身份牌。

description.en: Meet the villains; you may privately view one center card.
description.zh: 与反派互认，并可秘密查看一张中央牌。

description.en: Recognize your fellow villains. Win if no villain is caught.
description.zh: 辨认其他反派。若没有反派被捕则获胜。

description.en: Learn whether at least one neighboring player is an original villain.
description.zh: 获知至少一位相邻玩家是否为最初的反派。

description.en: Win by being caught. If you are caught, the ordinary hero and villain teams both lose.
description.zh: 被捕即可获胜；你被捕时，普通英雄与反派阵营均失败。

description.en: Recognize the Mad Scientist and help them get caught. With no final Scientist, you must be caught.
description.zh: 辨认疯狂科学家并帮助其被捕。若最终没有科学家，则需自己被捕。

description.en: Secretly notify one adjacent player that Annoying Lad bothered them.
description.zh: 必须秘密骚扰一位相邻玩家，让对方收到提示。

description.en: View either one other player’s card or two center cards.
description.zh: 查看另一名玩家的身份牌，或两张中央牌。

description.en: Exchange your card with another player and view your new card, without performing its action.
description.zh: 与另一名玩家交换身份并查看新牌，不再执行新身份的夜间技能。

description.en: You may view a center card; if you do, exchange it with any player, including yourself.
description.zh: 可查看一张中央牌；查看后必须与任意玩家交换，也可以是自己。

description.en: You may exchange two other players’ cards without looking at them.
description.zh: 可交换另外两名玩家的身份牌，不能查看牌面。

description.en: Look at your own card near the end of the night to see whether it changed.
description.zh: 在夜晚后期查看自己的身份牌，确认是否被调换。

description.en: Inspect another card. Leave it public only if it is a hero; Innocent Bystander stays hidden.
description.zh: 查看另一位玩家的牌。只有英雄牌可以保持公开；无辜路人不能公开。

description.en: No night action. You win with the heroes but do not count as a hero for Flipper.
description.zh: 夜间无行动。随英雄获胜，但翻牌侠不能将你当作英雄公开。
